name: prettyping
description: Wrapper to colorize and simplify ping's output

repo.name: prettyping
repo.description: `prettyping` is a wrapper around the standard `ping` tool, making the output prettier, more colorful, more compact, and easier to read.

readme.summary: The README clearly explains what prettyping does and covers installation well, but lacks any usage examples, command-line options documentation, or troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No usage examples or documentation of command-line flags/options — users must guess how to invoke it beyond the tool name itself.

common_complaints: SIGINT/Ctrl+C handling - program hangs without internet connection
Duplicate ping response packets not handled/displayed
Output formatting not working on some systems ('Just Ping, Not Pretty')
Missing command-line features (--version option, disable statistics)
Memory leak in awk subprocess after extended runtime
praise_themes: Project was inspirational enough to spawn a Rust port
Community respect shown in polite feature requests
sentiment.summary: Prettyping is appreciated and inspirational, but shows signs of slow/maintenance-mode development with 5 open issues—including critical signal handling and duplicate packet bugs—remaining unresolved since 2019-2025.

red_flags: repeated 'Actually, a duplicate of #2. Thanks!' responses
lack of detailed explanations for technical decisions
communication.summary: The maintainer is generally helpful and patient but could improve clarity and provide more technical depth in their responses.

concerns: 27 open issues with no resolution activity
No active contributors in past 6 months
No merged or pending pull requests
maintenance.summary: The prettyping project shows no maintenance activity for 6+ months with a growing backlog of unresolved issues and no active contributors.
